description: This file is a shell script implementing the backend for IPv6-in-IPv4 tunneling in OpenWrt, providing functions for setup, teardown, and configuration of 6in4 tunnels.

methods.name: test_6in4_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if the given IPv4 address is within private or special ranges (RFC 1918, RFC 6598).

methods.name: proto_6in4_update
methods.description: Runs a command with a timeout, used for updating tunnel status or performing network operations.

methods.name: proto_6in4_add_prefix
methods.description: Adds an IPv6 prefix to the configuration.

methods.name: proto_6in4_setup
methods.description: Main function to configure and initiate a 6in4 tunnel based on provided parameters.

methods.name: proto_6in4_teardown
methods.description: Placeholder for tearing down a configured 6in4 tunnel.

methods.name: proto_6in4_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration options for the 6in4 protocol.
